name: let-him-cook
description: Home-local Claude Code plugin for Wix internal engineering workflows.

MCP_S_TOKEN.title: Wix MCP gateway token (mcp-s)
MCP_S_TOKEN.description: Wix MCP gateway token (mcp-s). Required for the devex/grafana/root-cause/docs-schema/jira/slack MCP family. Skills run in degraded mode if unset and the readiness check surfaces the gap.

OCTOCODE_TOKEN.title: GitHub token for octocode MCP
OCTOCODE_TOKEN.description: GitHub token used by the octocode MCP for repo discovery and PR archaeology. Required for lhc-research and lhc-build-fix when the user expects PR-archaeology coverage.
